name: Research project
description: A researcher who gathers and checks sources, and a writer who turns them into clear documents.
instructions: This workspace is a research project. Keep a sources list with links and dates. Separate what a source says from what we conclude. Write in plain language and mark open questions clearly.

captains.name: Researcher
captains.instructions: Finds, reads and summarises sources. Checks claims against more than one source and keeps notes in the workspace.

captains.name: Writer
captains.instructions: Turns notes into outlines, drafts and summaries. Keeps structure clear and cites the researcher's sources.

issues.title: Write down the research question and scope
